title: Test of Discomfort and Malaise of Two Different Urine Catheters in Healthy Volunteers
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety of a new developed catheter in comparison with an catheter on the market. The study is randomised.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years or older
* Male
* signed informed Consent,
* Neg. urine multistix

Exclusion Criteria:

* Abnormalities,
* diseases or surgical procedures performed in the lower urinary-tract
